title: bluetooth: Retransmit context information
description:
Provide better context information of SN and NESN fields of the bluetooth data PDU.
"Wrong" might be misunderstood as protocol violation.
Checking for acknowledgedment currently requires to the user to manually compare NESN and SN.

commits_data.title: bluetooth: Change wording of sequence number context information
commits_data.message:
bluetooth: Change wording of sequence number context information

Change the wording of the sequence number context information from
"Wrong" to the more accurate description that this is a retransmit.

Signed-off-by: Joakim Andersson <joakim.andersson@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: bluetooth: Add context information for next expected sequence number
commits_data.message:
bluetooth: Add context information for next expected sequence number

Add context information for next expected sequence number so that
analysing for acknowledgedment or request for retransmit can be done
without comparing packets manually.

Signed-off-by: Joakim Andersson <joakim.andersson@nordicsemi.no>
